key.aboutfaceeasyplace.toggle_swaps: Toggle substitutes in the selected placement
Let Easy Place and the verifier accept other blocks in place of a schematic's, from profiles you make, placement by placement.
text.aboutfaceeasyplace.swaps_no_placeme: Substitutes: select a placement in Litematica, or stand in one
gui.aboutfaceeasyplace.all.tip: Pick every block the search shows.
gui.aboutfaceeasyplace.none.tip: Take out every block the search shows.
gui.aboutfaceeasyplace.substitutes.reset: Turns substitutes off in every placement loaded now, using all profiles again. Your profiles are kept.
gui.aboutfaceeasyplace.profile.tip: Groups: %s. Click to rename it or change its groups.
gui.aboutfaceeasyplace.switch.tip: On: in this placement, a substitute counts as the right block. The verifier calls it correct, the overlay shows nothing to do, and Easy Place puts it down when you have it and not the schematic's block (or hold it).
gui.aboutfaceeasyplace.profiles_button.t: Which of your profiles this placement uses.
gui.aboutfaceeasyplace.profile.reset: Removes every group in this profile.
gui.aboutfaceeasyplace.groups: Groups: every block in a group is a substitute for the others
gui.aboutfaceeasyplace.new_group.tip: Pick blocks that may be built in place of each other. A block already in another group joins the two groups. A stair only counts for a stair, a slab for a slab.
gui.aboutfaceeasyplace.pick_group: Blocks that substitute for each other
gui.aboutfaceeasyplace.placement.reset: Uses every profile in this placement again.
